results.title: Advancing research and partnering with universities in Singapore
results.description: With our newly established research hub in Singapore, and as we continue to scale existing health research initiatives in the country — including bringing open models like MedGemma to frontline care settings — Google is also deepening its academic partnerships in Singapore by investing over $6 million in new research grants and capacity-building initiatives at National University of Singapore (NUS) and Nanyang Technological University (NTU). Our targeted grants address both urgent biomedical frontiers and the core building blocks of computing: Alzheimer’s research ($1.5 million grant — NUS): Selected from over 3,500 global applications, NUS has been awarded an AI for Science Google.org Impact Challenge Grant to advance breakthroughs in neurodegenerative disease research using AI models and data science.
